title: Gate unblock: auto_fix_round must not KeyError on a missing goal under [planner].autonomous, and the test harness must not inherit the live autonomous flag
spec:
The base is red for every task since [planner].autonomous = true was committed (b6554ef): tests/_harness.py copies the repo's .orchestrator/pool.toml into the test root (tests/_harness.py:11), so daemon.auto_fix_round (daemon.py:141-215) takes the autonomous branch (daemon.py:~155: `if pool.cfg.get("planner", {}).get("autonomous") and decision.routes_enabled(...)`) and calls planner_runs.build_ctx(point, pool) (planner_runs.py:1013), which does bus.get(goal_id) for the held task's parent; the daemon tests create tasks with parent "T-0043" that never exists (tests/test_daemon.py:110, :334), so tests.test_daemon.Daemon.test_auto_fix_round_fires_on_missing_test_ids and test_auto_fix_round_on_gate_red_pytest_and_unittest_ids error with KeyError: 'T-0043' (verified in wt/T-0765 at 14:55).
Do:
1. daemon.py auto_fix_round: wrap the autonomous routing (build_ctx + decision.route) so that a goal missing from the bus (KeyError) or any exception inside build_ctx falls back to the non-autonomous path with `routine` computed as before (the code path that ran when autonomous was false), logging one warning line via notify() that names the task and the missing goal; never let a routing failure escape auto_fix_round.
2. tests/_harness.py: after copying pool.toml, force `[planner].autonomous = false` in the copied file (rewrite the line if present, else leave), so tests never depend on the live flag; add a comment saying why. Tests that need autonomous=true set it explicitly in their own fixture.
3. tests/test_daemon.py::test_auto_fix_round_survives_missing_goal_under_autonomous: with the harness cfg patched to autonomous=true and decision routes enabled, a held execute task whose parent goal does not exist still gets its routine fix round created (or is skipped with the warning) and no exception propagates.
Gate: .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 (the whole suite, including the two tests named above).
acceptance: tests/_harness.py forces [planner].autonomous = false in the copied pool.toml; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0
